name: bland
description: Work with Bland voice agents through the hosted MCP server: inspect agent versions, review calls, query metrics, validate supplied pathway graphs, and evaluate calls.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_agents and returns the v2 agent names and IDs in the connected organization. Does not label them as legacy pathways or invent their behavior.

positive.prompt: Show me the transcript and outcome of call <CALL_ID>.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_call_log with the supplied call ID and reports the returned status, duration, summary, and transcript evidence. Identifies missing fields without inventing routing traces or business outcomes.

positive.prompt: Between <SINCE_ISO8601> and <UNTIL_ISO8601>, how many Bland calls did I make and what share completed?
positive.expected_behavior: Queries total and completed calls over the supplied period using supported query_analytics fields. Reports the time range, denominator, and completion rate from results only; treats zero calls as an unavailable rate.

positive.prompt: How do I add a knowledge base to a pathway in Bland?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the Bland docs and answers with the documented steps and a link to the page.

positive.prompt: Show me the latest saved configuration for Bland agent <AGENT_ID>, without changing it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads agent metadata and its latest saved snapshot. Summarizes the returned configuration, omits any credentials, distinguishes it from deployment state, and makes no changes.

negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a linked list.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers the coding question without calling Bland tools, because it does not involve Bland.

negative.prompt: Show me the transcript of that Bland call.
negative.expected_behavior: In a fresh chat with no call ID, asks which call to inspect. Does not invent an ID, call get_call_log with a guessed value, or place a new call.

negative.prompt: Buy more Bland credits for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the plugin cannot purchase credits. Does not invoke purchase tools, collect payment details, start checkout, or use an alternate API route.

review.commerce_description: The ChatGPT plugin does not sell digital credits or subscriptions or initiate checkout. Calls and evaluation runs can consume existing Bland entitlements. Purchase tools and purchase routes must be unavailable to its OAuth connection.

publication.release_notes: First ChatGPT directory release: OAuth connection and skills for v2 agents, calls, aggregate analytics, supplied pathway graph validation, evaluations with existing judges, and Bland documentation.

interface.longDescription:
Manage your Bland voice agents from ChatGPT. Review call transcripts and outcomes, check call volume and completion rates, and inspect saved agent configurations.

Ask Bland to place or stop a call, save an agent change, or deploy a selected version. You can also validate a supplied pathway graph, score calls with existing evaluation judges, and find answers in Bland's documentation.

Requires a Bland account and access to the connected organization. Sign in through Bland to connect. Calls and evaluation runs may consume your existing Bland credits. Pathway validation requires the graph's nodes and edges. Available actions depend on your account permissions and connected tools.
